text_block_list.text:
The Nikkei Sho is here, and Narita
Taishin returns
to Nakayama Racecourse
once again.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Her heart is full of apprehension—she
wants to
run like she did in the Satsuki
Sho... But what if a
repeat of the Kikuka
Sho occurs?
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Despite this fear, she finds her feet
again after
some reassuring words.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
